technique_name: Describe the data pre-processing steps in a machine learning project
description: Data pre-processing is an important step in any machine learning project. It involves transforming raw datasets into ready-to-use form so that models can be trained with it. Common steps of data pre-processing include data cleaning, feature engineering, data normalization, and feature selection. Data cleaning involves identifying and addressing any errors, outliers, or missing values.
